candidates.description: The Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) scale used to assess how a patient's disease affects their daily living abilities.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Search for 'ECOG' or 'performance status' followed by a numeric value.
candidates.measurement_definition: A score from 0 (fully active) to 4 (completely disabled).
candidates.name: ECOG Performance Status
candidates.uncertainty: The evidence only contains values 0, 1, and 2; it is unclear if scores 3 or 4 occur in the broader population.

candidates.description: Cumulative lifetime tobacco exposure measured in pack-years.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Extract the numeric value associated with 'pack‑years' or 'pack-year history'.
candidates.measurement_definition: The number of packs of cigarettes smoked per day multiplied by the number of years the person smoked.
candidates.name: Smoking History (Pack-Years)
candidates.uncertainty: Consistency in reporting varies slightly between 'pack-year history' and 'pack-years'.

limitations: The provided evidence represents a small subset of patients.
Smoking history is predominantly provided for former smokers.
summary: The evidence describes baseline clinical characteristics of patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), specifically documenting functional status (ECOG), smoking history, and common comorbidities such as hypertension and hyperlipidemia.
